narrative.overview: Three temporary, unapproved alternatives for АкваЛайнПрофи: Modern Minimal, Premium Engineering and Clean & Friendly. This record describes local preview implementation only; no direction replaces the production identity. The owner will choose later.
keyCharacteristics: Minimal: calm editorial rows, fine rules, panoramic photograph.
Engineering: ruled dossier grid, navy surfaces, manifold photograph.
Friendly: aqua and teal surfaces, blue action, rounded photographs and pills.
dos: Do keep all three concepts scoped to local previews until the owner chooses.
Do reuse approved contacts, service content, SVG icons and the existing ContactForm in both placements.
Do retain explicit illustrative-image and unpublished-article disclosures.
donts: Don't publish these previews or promote their tokens into the production design system.
Don't claim illustrative photographs are company projects or topics are published articles.
Don't transmit or save form data or simulate successful delivery.
